scope: Public code, weights, licenses, pinned identities and local integration constraints; no model code executed or GPU jobs started by this audit.
eligibility_definition: Published inference code and model weights or adapter under Apache-2.0; this is not a claim that all training data is released.

leaderboard.note: Several current rows record openness/license as unknown. The publisher sources below independently establish availability. Besides Cygnet, Winnow, Jev-Omni, djev, Jev and Decider, the top-10 overall/top-10 Jev-class capability union contains these five families and Decision 4B v1.1 as an older variant. Published weights are identified below; exact v1.5.4 reviewed-container equivalence is not asserted.

models.name: Decision 4B v1.2 (FlyMyJev)
models.license: Apache-2.0 (adapter, code and configuration; Qwen base separately Apache-2.0)
models.evaluation_permission: Explicitly permits downloading, independent evaluation and publication; explicitly states code and adapter weights are Apache-2.0. Preview wording does not impose an evaluation-only adapter license.

protocol.adapter: LoRA rank 16, alpha 32; merged into BF16 base before inference
protocol.prompt: Publisher chat template with thinking disabled; system prompt in model.py; one JSON user payload {evidence, criterion, options[{letter, description}]}; description is key + ': ' + description; noul order true then false.
protocol.readout: Last real prompt token hidden state projected in FP32 onto A-Z output embedding rows; softmax over offered options only at temperature 1.45; no generation.
protocol.score_wire_value: Expected ordinal index; complete probability distribution also returned
protocol.checksum_source: Publisher manifest.json; source/config checksums independently verified; adapter not downloaded by this audit
protocol.publisher_package_check: JevBench v1.4.2, 231 public items: bundled in-process adapter and HTTP server both 203/231; unfolded adapter 204/231. Merging in BF16 changes near-ties, so preserve the published merge path.

models.cached_evidence: Pinned API metadata, manifest and all 17 non-weight manifest files; SHA256 of every downloaded manifest file matches. Adapter weights were not downloaded by this audit.
models.native_integration: Load pinned model.py by importlib file spec, then module.load(assets=local_pinned_base_path, device='cuda', graphs=False). For each typed question use model.decide(state, question)['probabilities'], preserving state and question/option order. Existing typed_questions/decode_typed can wrap this. Direct native import avoids jevbench_adapter.py's relative .base import.
local_constraints: verify() hashes every manifest member and rejects symlinks; a source-only checkout will not load until adapter weights are present. Preserve files byte-for-byte or use a separate wrapper.
The native loader accepts a local base path and does not verify that path's revision; pass the recorded pinned base snapshot.

Pure Python loader/server have no observed POSIX shell dependency. FLA/Triton acceleration and CUDA graph capture still require Windows smoke testing. causal-conv1d is explicitly optional in requirements.txt.

graphs=False uses the publisher's eager readout and avoids graph capture; publisher loader also catches capture failures and falls back to eager. Report eager latency separately from publisher CUDA-graph timings.
Loads/merges BF16 on CPU before moving to GPU; retain enough host RAM and GPU memory. No native quantization option is exposed.
The 26-option cap rejects wide classification tasks unless separately reported as an altered protocol; no native knockout implementation is present.

models.name: Surogate Rune 26B-A4B v3
models.license: Apache-2.0 (publisher weights card and Surogate code)
models.code_revision_scope: Current public source inspected; not asserted to be the exact ranked runtime revision
local_constraints: Official HF files require authentication and acceptance of contact-information sharing. Unauthenticated history/file access was denied; no gate accepted and no credentials accessed by this audit.
Despite the GGUF repository name, current v3 is 11 BF16 safetensors shards totaling 51.6 GB; old v1 GGUF exists at historical revision 2a15504. Publisher says no v3 GGUF builds yet.
26.5B total parameters, about 4B active. Reference BF16 checkpoint exceeds a 16 GB local GPU; publisher serves on 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 with additional KV-cache capacity.
Native endpoint /api/alpha/decisions uses publisher prompt and letter-logit readout. Recommended text decision temperature 2; thinking off for one-pass comparison.
Publisher recommends a Surogate build containing MoE router fix #217. Missing capacity/access is a local execution limitation, not a missing open-source license.

models.name: JevK5 v0.3 (4B)
models.cached_identity_confirmed: Existing cached revision is already v0.3, not v0.2. HF commit dated 2026-09-25 explicitly names v0.3; local jevk5_config.json has temperature 1.22 and knockout_temperature 0.93.
local_constraints: Use runtime >=0.3.0 to read per-model knockout_temperature for more than 16 options.
Merged BF16 model.safetensors is 8,411,558,400 bytes; native letter-logit readout, not generic text generation.

models.name: Plumb-4B
models.code_revision_scope: Publisher's pinned v5.2 server command for JevBench v1.5
models.cached_identity_confirmed: Existing cached 24f7bf77 revision adds model-card guidance for v5.2 readout. Publisher explicitly says weights remain the v5 release at 55de037801a8a9b9de3db5c0e16cef86210c2186.
local_constraints: Merged JevK5-v0.2-derived Qwen3.5-4B; native JevK5 runtime reads T=2.07; card estimates about 10 GB free GPU memory for BF16.

Publisher's v1.5 benchmark command uses its own server with --one-read --temperature 2.07 --noul-commit --score-temperature 1.2. Existing generic JevK5 runtime evaluation should not be represented as exact reproduction of that readout.

models.name: Imajev-4B
models.license: Apache-2.0 (adapter/readout weights and code; Qwen base Apache-2.0)
models.cached_identity_confirmed: Existing cache pins f8d8234c. Release spec identifies phase-3 weights first published as c9e5f132; latest commit reverts model-card text, while intervening releases add optional modality calibration files.
local_constraints: LoRA rank 64/alpha 128 plus trained 256-code decision readout; load both adapter and decision_readout.safetensors with the publisher runtime.

Single-pass and four-rotation modes, and several calibration files, must be recorded distinctly. Default recommendation uses four rotations; model card reports historical JevBench v1.4.2.2 with --rotations 1 --calibration calibration.json (T=1.305). Current v1.5.4 reviewed-bundle equivalence not verified.
